{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Enable Gas Transmission Pipeline''' is a natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref name=Q4>[http://investors.enablemidstream.com/sites/enablemidstream.investorhq.businesswire.com/files/event/additional/2017-Q4_IR_Presentation_vF_Rev2.pdf Enable Midstream Fourth Quarter 2017 Investor Presentation], Enable Midstream Partners, Q4 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs within Louisiana, Arkansas, Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas.<ref name=Q4>[http://investors.enablemidstream.com/sites/enablemidstream.investorhq.businesswire.com/files/event/additional/2017-Q4_IR_Presentation_vF_Rev2.pdf Enable Midstream Fourth Quarter 2017 Investor Presentation], Enable Midstream Partners, Q4 2017</ref> Route below adapted from the EIA Layer Information for Interactive State Maps database.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/maps/layer_info-m.php|title=Layer Information for Interactive State Maps|website=www.eia.gov|access-date=2021-11-19}}</ref>{{#display_map:

==Background==
The Enable Gas Transmission (EGT) Pipeline is one part of the system formerly known as the CenterPoint Energy Gas Transmission Pipeline.<ref>[http://bit.ly/2skHnKP Centerpoint Energy Gas Transmission Pipeline,] A Barrel Full, accessed Aug. 25, 2021.</ref> The pipeline is operated by Enable Midstream Partners, a partnership between CenterPoint Energy and OGE Energy created in 2013.<ref>[http://fuelfix.com/blog/2013/08/01/centerpoint-oge-partnership-dubbed-enable-midstream-partners/ CenterPoint, OGE partnership dubbed Enable Midstream Partners], ''Houston Chronicle'', Aug. 1, 2013, accessed Aug. 25, 2021.</ref>

==Expansion projects==
===MASS Expansion Project===
The expansion project will increase takeaway capacity out of Anadarko Basin in Oklahoma, USA. The project does not include adding any new miles of pipeline.<ref name="eiaapr21" /> According to the U.S. Energy Information Administration, as of April 2021 the project had been approved by FERC.<ref name="eiaapr21">[https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php U.S. natural gas pipeline projects], U.S. Energy Information Administration.</ref> As of October 2022 the project was listed as completed.
*'''Operator: '''Enable Gas Transmission LLC<ref name="eiaapr21" />
*'''Owner: '''Enable Gas Transmission LLC
*'''Parent company:''' Energy Transfer (via Enable Midstream Partners LP)
*'''Capacity:''' 100 MMcf/d<ref name="eiaapr21" />
*'''Length: ''' 0.0 new miles
*'''Cost: '''35.9 million USD<ref name="eiaapr21" />
*'''Status:''' Operating<ref name=eiaapr21/>
*'''Start year: '''2022<ref name="eiaapr21" />
